title: Require Map Mod Project Root Topology
forbids: workspace map-mod projects without their package, Nx project, and source spine; reusable definitions without a closed pure-authoring interior and exact target proof; or loose project-root children outside the finite project topology
why: A workspace map-mod project is one constructible package and Nx project with authored source. Reusable definitions additionally own one closed pure-authoring face for configuration admission, serialization, and finite metadata targets, with one exact proof of that table. Closing both project families and the definition authoring interior prevents loose cabinets, host effects, and compatibility surfaces from becoming accidental peers of their qualified owners.
remediate: Keep package.json, project.json, and src at every map-mod project root. Definition projects also require authoring/config.ts, authoring/index.ts, authoring/targets.ts, and test/authoring/targets.test.ts; keep host filesystem effects outside that authoring interior. Place transitional tools under scripts, behavior proof under test, generated or materialized outputs under dist or mod, and remove or relocate every other root child unless it is one of the admitted project configuration or documentation files.
message: Workspace map-mod projects must match the closed project-root and definition-authoring topology.
